english: to Him who [ought] to be feared
They came out like a whirlwind
but I scattered them with a whirlwind
so that is in an uproar
they shall make a loud noise
one of those who shakes in a pledge
He shall take them away as with a whirlwind
for as the fear of You
is it because of your fear of Him
then you shall sound an alarm
For I will cause to be dismayed
at the terror which they caused
and he was moved with rage
and shall come like a whirlwind
